title: Camera Ready for Collection
transcript:
Hello. I had a message about my camera. Could you check whether it's ready before I come into town?
Of course. What's the name on the repair ticket?
Hughes. The screen kept going dark, so I assumed I'd need a whole new one.
It's ready, yes. The screen itself was fine. The technician replaced the power switch and tested it yesterday.
That's good news. Do I just go to the tills when I arrive?
Use the service desk near the back stairs. They keep all the finished repairs there now.
I might be in a bit of a hurry. Can I check the camera before I pay?
Certainly. We've put a charged battery in it so you can try it at the desk.
Great. My partner might get there first. Could she pick it up for me?
Yes. Just forward her the collection message. We'll scan the barcode from her phone.

questions.explanation: 来电者报出维修单上的姓氏 Hughes。
店员说屏幕本身正常，维修人员更换了电源开关。
店员请顾客到后楼梯旁的服务台领取相机。

questions.prompt: What has the shop done so the customer can test the camera?
options: Connected it to a mains adaptor
questions.explanation: 店员说相机里已经装了充好电的电池，方便顾客现场试机。

questions.prompt: What should the customer's partner show if she collects the camera?
options: A photo of the repair ticket
questions.explanation: 店员请顾客转发取货消息，以便从代领人的手机上扫描条形码。
